articles.title: Wild Card Series Game 2: Red Sox-Yankees preview and lineups
articles.description: Sonny Gray will be on the mound as the Red Sox look to stave off elimination at Yankee Stadium.
articles.category: ALWC Game 2, Red Sox at Yankees | 8 p.m. (NBC, Peacock)

articles.title: There’s no love lost between Sonny Gray and the Yankees, and now he’s leading the Red Sox in a must-win against them
articles.description: The worst stretch of the righthander's career came during two seasons in New York, but he rebounded, landed with the Sox, and gets the start in Game 2.

articles.title: Roman Anthony’s injury instantly clouds Red Sox’ playoff hopes, especially in must-win Game 2
articles.description: Ceddanne Rafaela and Jarren Duran also showed signs of being less than 100 percent in Tuesday's opener.

articles.title: Michael King flirts with no-hitter, Padres crush Cubs in Game 1 of NL Wild Card Series
articles.description: Fernando Tatis Jr. homered on the first pitch of the game as San Diego pushed Chicago to the brink of elimination.

articles.title: Red Sox’ season returns to the brink as Yankees pull away to win AL Wild Card Series Game 1 in a rout
articles.description: The Red Sox will try to do what the Yankees did last year: win the next two after dropping the opener. “I haven’t heard the fat lady sing yet,” Payton Tolle said. “I believe in us.”

articles.title: Once again, the Red Sox have absolutely no answer for electric Cam Schlittler
articles.description: The ace from Walpole has a 4-1 record against the Red Sox and a 0.47 ERA.

articles.title: Red Sox team forged on adversity finds itself back on the ropes via Yankees’ dynamic Massachusetts duo
articles.description: The Sox have been resilient all season. Everyone counted them out. That’s all you’ve got to make yourself feel hopeful at this hour.

articles.title: Yankees 9, Red Sox 0: Mass. natives Cam Schlittler, Ben Rice push Boston to brink of elimination
articles.description: The Red Sox mustered just three hits in a listless showing.

articles.title: How will Red Sox use Garrett Crochet, added to the Wild Card Series roster? Chad Tracy won’t say.
articles.description: The Red Sox ace was added to the bullpen for the ALWC against the Yankees. "I was on the [injured list] far longer than I wanted to be, but that’s in the past now," he said.

articles.title: Can the Red Sox handle the heat? It’s proven velocity jumps in the postseason.
articles.description: The Red Sox were one of the least-productive teams in baseball against pitches of 95 miles per hour or greater during the regular season.

articles.title: Roman Anthony replaced by pinch hitter after experiencing ‘more serious’ discomfort in his right hand
articles.description: Anthony, who missed 101 games with a torn ligament in his right hand this season, struck out in his first two plate appearances against Cam Schlittler.

articles.title: Colson Montgomery homers, White Sox beat Astros in Game 1 of AL Wild Card Series
articles.description: Chicago held on for its first playoff win since Oct. 10, 2021 in the ALDS against Houston.

articles.title: Payton Tolle and Cam Schlittler have risen to stardom the same way: with a three-fastball power arsenal
articles.description: Tolle and Schlittler both learned from current Red Sox director of pitching Ben Buck, who saw them achieve tremendous success with four-seamers, sinkers, and cutters.

articles.title: Austin Riley’s late go-ahead home run powers Braves to NL Wild Card Series Game 1 win over Phillies
articles.description: Riley's home run in the eighth inning off of Phillies closer Jhoan Duran marked the first signature moment of the MLB postseason.

articles.title: Wild Card Series Game 1: Red Sox-Yankees preview and lineups
articles.description: Ceddanne Rafaela is expected to be in the lineup when the Red Sox open their wild-card series in New York.
articles.category: ALWC Game 1, Red Sox at Yankees | 8 p.m. (NBC, Peacock)

articles.title: NESN sees big increase in Red Sox viewership during team’s hot second half
articles.description: Nine of its top 10 most-viewed broadcasts on the linear NESN network occurred after the All-Star break.
